info.name: EventEase - 14 Core API Tests
info.description: Send requests 01-14 one at a time and in order. Each request description explains the steps, expected result, and screenshot name.

exec: pm.collectionVariables.set('eventDate', new Date(Date.now() + 30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString());
const name = pm.info.requestName;
const expected = {
'01 Register Admin': 201, '02 Register User': 201, '03 Login Admin': 200, '04 Login User': 200,
'05 Admin creates event': 201, '06 Get upcoming events': 200, '07 User cannot create event': 403,
'08 Create event without token': 401, '09 Too many seats': 400, '10 Register for event': 201,
'11 Duplicate registration': 409, '12 Get my registrations': 200, '13 Cancel registration': 200,
'14 Verify restored seats': 200
pm.test('Expected HTTP status ' + expected[name], function () { pm.response.to.have.status(expected[name]); });
let data = {};
try { data = pm.response.json(); } catch (error) { data = {}; }
if (name === '03 Login Admin' && data.token) pm.collectionVariables.set('adminToken', data.token);
if (name === '04 Login User' && data.token) pm.collectionVariables.set('userToken', data.token);
if (name === '05 Admin creates event' && data.event && data.event._id) pm.collectionVariables.set('eventId', data.event._id);
if (name === '10 Register for event' && data.registration && data.registration._id) pm.collectionVariables.set('regId', data.registration._id);
if (name === '12 Get my registrations' && data.registrations && data.registrations.length) pm.collectionVariables.set('regId', data.registrations[0]._id);
if (name === '01 Register Admin') pm.test('Admin account was created', function () { pm.expect(data.user.role).to.eql('Admin'); });
if (name === '02 Register User') pm.test('Normal user account was created', function () { pm.expect(data.user.role).to.eql('User'); });
if (name === '05 Admin creates event') pm.test('Event has five available seats', function () { pm.expect(data.event.availableSeats).to.eql(5); });

if (name === '06 Get upcoming events') pm.test('The new event appears in the list', function () { pm.expect(data.events.some(function (event) { return event._id === pm.collectionVariables.get('eventId'); })).to.eql(true); });
if (name === '07 User cannot create event') pm.test('Access is denied to a normal user', function () { pm.expect(data.message).to.eql('Only admin can do this'); });
if (name === '08 Create event without token') pm.test('Missing token is rejected', function () { pm.expect(data.message).to.eql('No token, access denied'); });
if (name === '09 Too many seats') pm.test('Insufficient seats are reported', function () { pm.expect(data.message).to.include('Only 5 seats available'); });

if (name === '10 Register for event') pm.test('Two seats are booked and three remain', function () { pm.expect(data.availableSeatsNow).to.eql(3); pm.expect(data.registration.totalAmount).to.eql(200); });
if (name === '11 Duplicate registration') pm.test('Duplicate registration is rejected', function () { pm.expect(data.message).to.eql('You already registered for this event'); });

if (name === '12 Get my registrations') pm.test('The user sees their confirmed registration', function () { pm.expect(data.count).to.eql(1); pm.expect(data.registrations[0].registrationStatus).to.eql('Confirmed'); });

if (name === '13 Cancel registration') pm.test('Cancellation restores five seats', function () { pm.expect(data.registration.registrationStatus).to.eql('Cancelled'); pm.expect(data.availableSeatsNow).to.eql(5); });
if (name === '14 Verify restored seats') pm.test('Event now has five available seats', function () { pm.expect(data.event.availableSeats).to.eql(5); });

item.name: 01 Register Admin
item.description:
STEP: Click Send.
METHOD: POST
URL: {{baseUrl}}/api/auth/register
BODY: Admin name, unique test email, password, and role Admin.
EXPECTED: 201 Created; response user.role is Admin.
SCREENSHOT: 01_register_admin.png (show URL, Body, response, and status).

exec: pm.collectionVariables.set('runId', Date.now().toString());

item.name: 02 Register User
item.description:
STEP: Click Send.
METHOD: POST
URL: {{baseUrl}}/api/auth/register
BODY: Normal user name, email, and password. The email uses the same unique run ID as Test 01.
EXPECTED: 201 Created; response user.role is User.
SCREENSHOT: 02_register_user.png (show URL, Body, response, and status).

item.name: 03 Login Admin
item.description:
STEP: Click Send. The collection saves the returned JWT as adminToken.
METHOD: POST
URL: {{baseUrl}}/api/auth/login
BODY: Admin email and password from Test 01.
EXPECTED: 200 OK; response contains a token and user.role Admin.
SCREENSHOT: 03_login_admin.png (show URL, Body, response, and status).

item.name: 04 Login User
item.description:
STEP: Click Send. The collection saves the returned JWT as userToken.
METHOD: POST
URL: {{baseUrl}}/api/auth/login
BODY: User email and password from Test 02.
EXPECTED: 200 OK; response contains a token and user.role User.
SCREENSHOT: 04_login_user.png (show URL, Body, response, and status).

item.name: 05 Admin creates event
item.description:
STEP: Click Send. The admin token is added automatically; the event ID is saved for later requests.
METHOD: POST
URL: {{baseUrl}}/api/events
AUTH: Bearer {{adminToken}}
BODY: Tech Fest with a future date, five seats, and fee 100.
EXPECTED: 201 Created; availableSeats is 5.
SCREENSHOT: 05_admin_create_event.png (show URL, Body, response, and status).

item.name: 06 Get upcoming events
item.description:
STEP: Click Send.
METHOD: GET
URL: {{baseUrl}}/api/events?search=tech&category=Technology&page=1&limit=5
EXPECTED: 200 OK; events array includes the event created in Test 05.
SCREENSHOT: 06_get_events.png (show full URL/Params, response, and status).

item.name: 07 User cannot create event
item.description:
STEP: Click Send. The normal-user token is added automatically.
METHOD: POST
URL: {{baseUrl}}/api/events
AUTH: Bearer {{userToken}}
BODY: Event JSON (the request should be denied before event creation).
EXPECTED: 403 Forbidden; message is Only admin can do this.
SCREENSHOT: 07_user_forbidden.png (show URL, Body, Authorization, response, and status).

item.name: 08 Create event without token
item.description:
STEP: Click Send. Do not add an Authorization header.
METHOD: POST
URL: {{baseUrl}}/api/events
BODY: Event JSON.
EXPECTED: 401 Unauthorized; message is No token, access denied.
SCREENSHOT: 08_no_token.png (show URL, Body, that no Authorization header is sent, response, and status).

item.name: 09 Too many seats
item.description:
STEP: Click Send. The normal-user token and event ID are added automatically.
METHOD: POST
URL: {{baseUrl}}/api/registrations
AUTH: Bearer {{userToken}}
BODY: eventId {{eventId}}, numberOfSeats 10.
EXPECTED: 400 Bad Request; message says only five seats are available. No seats should be changed.
SCREENSHOT: 09_insufficient_seats.png (show URL, Body, response, and status).

item.name: 10 Register for event
item.description:
STEP: Click Send. The normal-user token and event ID are added automatically.
METHOD: POST
URL: {{baseUrl}}/api/registrations
AUTH: Bearer {{userToken}}
BODY: eventId {{eventId}}, numberOfSeats 2.
EXPECTED: 201 Created; totalAmount is 200 and availableSeatsNow is 3.
SCREENSHOT: 10_register_event.png (show URL, Body, response, and status).

item.name: 11 Duplicate registration
item.description:
STEP: Click Send again with the same user and event.
METHOD: POST
URL: {{baseUrl}}/api/registrations
AUTH: Bearer {{userToken}}
BODY: eventId {{eventId}}, numberOfSeats 1.
EXPECTED: 409 Conflict; message is You already registered for this event.
SCREENSHOT: 11_duplicate_registration.png (show URL, Body, response, and status).

item.name: 12 Get my registrations
item.description:
STEP: Click Send. The registration ID is saved automatically for cancellation.
METHOD: GET
URL: {{baseUrl}}/api/registrations/my
AUTH: Bearer {{userToken}}
EXPECTED: 200 OK; count is 1 and registrationStatus is Confirmed.
SCREENSHOT: 12_my_registrations.png (show URL, Authorization, response, and status).

item.name: 13 Cancel registration
item.description:
STEP: Click Send. The user token and registration ID are added automatically.
METHOD: PUT
URL: {{baseUrl}}/api/registrations/{{regId}}/cancel
AUTH: Bearer {{userToken}}
EXPECTED: 200 OK; registrationStatus is Cancelled and availableSeatsNow is 5.
SCREENSHOT: 13_cancel_registration.png (show URL, Authorization, response, and status).

item.name: 14 Verify restored seats
item.description:
STEP: Click Send.
METHOD: GET
URL: {{baseUrl}}/api/events/{{eventId}}
EXPECTED: 200 OK; event.availableSeats is 5 again.
SCREENSHOT: 14_seats_restored.png (show URL, response, and status).
